AP15.name: Required balance not maintained
AP15.description: Mandate registration failed: required balance not maintained in the customer bank account for initial validation debit or mandate setup.
AP15.customer_friendly_cause: Your bank account did not have the minimum balance required for mandate registration verification.
AP15.recommended_fix: Retry registration using another linked bank account with sufficient balance.

AP10.name: Account closed / Invalid Account
AP10.description: Mandate registration failed: target bank account is closed, dormant, or invalid according to destination bank records.
AP10.customer_friendly_cause: The selected bank account is closed, dormant, or invalid.
AP10.recommended_fix: Select an active primary savings account to complete mandate registration.

LMS_POST_CLOSURE_DEBIT.name: EMI debited after loan closure
LMS_POST_CLOSURE_DEBIT.description: Automated NACH presentation cycle triggered after confirmed loan foreclosure or full repayment date.
LMS_POST_CLOSURE_DEBIT.customer_friendly_cause: Your loan was closed before the debit date, but the automated bank presentation cycle had already been dispatched.
LMS_POST_CLOSURE_DEBIT.recommended_fix: Initiate automated refund ticket, issue No-Dues Certificate (NOC), and log credit bureau correction request.

VKYC_NET_DROP.name: Video KYC session disconnected
VKYC_NET_DROP.description: Video KYC connection dropped due to network instability or browser disconnect before verification checklist completion.
VKYC_NET_DROP.customer_friendly_cause: Your video KYC call was interrupted due to network connectivity issues before verification completed.
VKYC_NET_DROP.recommended_fix: Send an instant resume link valid for 72 hours with pre-call checklist.

LMS_REJECT_OBLIGATION.name: High existing debt obligations
LMS_REJECT_OBLIGATION.description: Application paused due to existing active loan obligations exceeding eligible debt-to-income threshold.
LMS_REJECT_OBLIGATION.customer_friendly_cause: Current active EMI commitments exceed eligible lending limits at this time.
LMS_REJECT_OBLIGATION.recommended_fix: Schedule a reminder after 90 days to re-check eligibility without affecting credit score.
